s1.syndrome_frame: Acute hip pain with difficulty walking in an elderly patient with a history of osteoporosis treatment and previous hip surgery
salient_findings: Incomplete transverse fracture in the lateral cortex of the right femoral neck
key_facts: 76-year-old woman
One week of right hip pain
Difficulty walking
Received denosumab for osteoporosis for five years
Underwent total hip arthroplasty for a left femoral neck fracture two years earlier
JOA score was 96 on the right and 76 on the left
Initial plain radiographs were reportedly normal
Repeat radiographs demonstrated an incomplete transverse fracture in the lateral cortex of the right femoral neck
Bone mineral density was 0.840 g/cm2 in the lumbar spine and 0.899 g/cm2 in the right femoral neck
Laboratory studies revealed abnormal levels of calcium, phosphorus, alkaline phosphatase, and other bone turnover markers
